ORDINANCE CTIA N. 24, 7024

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit Districts symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 3-l in an area bound by:

The alley next north of and parallel to West Cortez Street; a line 295.38 feet east of and parallel to North

Rockwell Street; West Cortez Street; and a line 265.38 feet east of and parallel to North Rockwell Street.

To those of a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2534 W Cortez St, Chicago, IL 60622
